plugins.name: coding-guidelines
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines for clean, surgical, goal-driven coding

plugins.name: git-safety
plugins.description: Prevents Claude from running git write commands (skill + PreToolUse hook); /git-safety:commit-queue hands commits back as a verified queue

plugins.name: manual-work-coordination
plugins.description: Stop cleanly when the user takes over a task by hand; don't redo, override, or re-verify their manual work

plugins.name: docs-sync
plugins.description: Keeps docs, request collections, test scripts, and observability artifacts in step with changes (skill + Stop hook)

plugins.name: friction
plugins.description: Log small frictions to FRICTION.md in the moment; /friction:find sweeps the session for missed ones, /friction:review triages and fixes the open ones

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Managed Claude Code status line: /statusline:install wires it up once, a SessionStart hook keeps it in step with plugin updates
